hopeful.text: costs 2 less if you've already played another card this turn.

forer.text: when it dies, play two 3-might Mech unit tokens to your base.

tideturner.text: When played, you may pick a friendly unit: the two swap locations.

scuttle.text: 0 might but can still conquer/hold. On play, draw 1. Deathknell: an opponent reveals their hand; gain 1 XP.

vex.text: While she's at a battlefield, units an opponent plays are stunned and can't move that turn.

watcher.text: When played, all enemy units get -3 might this turn (not below 1).

fan.text: When it defends, you may kill it to send an attacking unit back to its base.

yasuo.text: When he attacks, he deals damage equal to his might to an enemy unit there.

dianaLunari.text: When a showdown starts here, may pay 1 energy: Predict, then reveal the top card; draw it if it's a spell.

hwei.text: When he moves, draw 1 then discard 1; bonus by discarded type: spell draw 1, gear ready 2 runes, unit +3 might.

porobot.text: If you control 3 or more other gear when played, draw 1.

shen.text: Reaction (can be played any time). Shield 2. Tank: must be assigned combat damage first.

recruit.text: Token unit with no text: a 1-might Recruit.

sprite.text: Token unit: 3 might with Temporary (dies at the start of its controller's next Beginning Phase, before scoring).

gold.text: Kill this and exhaust it to add 1 power of any colour.

discipline.text: A unit gets +2 might this turn. Draw 1.

defy.text: Counter a spell that costs at most 4 energy and at most 1 power.

gust.text: Return a unit at a battlefield with 3 or less might to its owner's hand.

cleave.text: A unit gets Assault 3 this turn (+3 might while attacking).

odds.text: A friendly unit at a battlefield gets +2 might this turn for each enemy unit there.

stupefy.text: A unit gets -1 might this turn (not below 1). Draw 1.

falling.text: Deal 3 to a unit, then deal 3 to a unit again. No Action/Reaction: main-phase speed only.

ride.text: Move a friendly unit, then ready it.

ray.text: Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield.

punch.text: A unit gets +5 might this turn.

moonfall.text: Pick a battlefield with your units; may pull one enemy unit there; enemies there get -2 might this turn.

stacked.text: Look at your top 3 cards, put 1 in hand, recycle the rest.

wages.text: Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield and play an exhausted Gold gear token.

lullaby.text: Counter a spell; its controller can't play spells for the rest of the turn.

abandon.text: Counter a spell but return it to its owner's hand instead of the trash. Predict.

dredge.text: Draw 1. Flow 2: can be cast from your trash for 2 energy, then banished.

singularity.text: Deal 6 to each of up to two units.

hardBargain.text: Counter a spell unless its controller pays 2 energy. Repeat for 2 energy.

eclipse.text: A unit gets -4 might this turn. Predict.

flash.text: Move up to two friendly units back to base.

charm.text: Move an enemy unit. No Action/Reaction: main-phase speed only.

voidseeker.text: Deal 4 to a unit at a battlefield. Draw 1.

flourish.text: Deal 3 to an enemy unit. If it dies this turn, make a Gold token.

morbid.text: Return a unit from your trash to your hand.

zhonya.text: The next time a friendly unit would die, kill this instead and recall that unit exhausted to base.

pack.text: Exhaust: return another friendly gear, unit, or Hidden card to its owner's hand.

trove.text: When it leaves the board: draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted. Pay 1 Chaos power + exhaust: kill this.

aurora.text: At the end of your turn, reveal from the top until a unit; play it free; recycle the rest.

promoter.text: assigned combat damage last. When it holds, Buff every unit there.

revna.text: can move battlefield to battlefield. Readies when you play a spell paid with 4+ energy.

pouty.text: opponents pay 1 extra power of any domain to target it with a spell or ability.

mystic.text: when played, look at your top card; you may recycle it.

gloryseeker.text: if you've played another card this turn, it gets a +1 might buff when played.

gromp.text: gain 3 XP whenever it conquers or holds.

soulspinner.text: may be played as a Reaction to a battlefield where you have units.

pakaa.text: hide it facedown for 1 power, then play it on a later turn at Reaction speed for 0 energy.

spriteBurst.text: Play two ready 3-might Sprite tokens with Temporary (they die at your next Beginning Phase).

cloth.text: Equipment granting Shield 2. Quick-Draw: Reaction speed, attaches on play. Equip: 1 Mind power.

dorans.text: Equipment, +2 might. Equip: pay 1 Body power to attach it to your unit.

veteran.text: when played, may attach one of your Equipment to it for 1 power less.

feral.text: A unit gets +2 might this turn. Repeat: pay 2 more energy to do it again.

punching.text: Empower by discarding 1. While Empowered, it has +1 might.

banner.text: played only to a battlefield, dies if an opponent holds there. Your units there have Assault.

peddler.text: when it attacks, an enemy unit there gets -1 might this turn.

construct.text: Show Off a Mech (reveal one from hand or pick a friendly one); if you did, it enters ready.

gemhand.text: Hunt 1. Level 6: while you have 6+ XP, it has +1 might.

rabadon.text: Unique (max 1 copy per deck). Equipment +3 might; your spells and abilities deal 3 bonus damage.

kaisaL.text: Reaction, exhaust: add 1 power of any domain, usable only to play spells.

dianaL.text: Reaction, exhaust: add 1 energy that can only be spent during showdowns.

dravenL.text: Whenever you win a combat, draw 1.

shenL.text: Action, exhaust: give a friendly unit Tank this turn.

ireliaL.text: When you choose a friendly unit, may exhaust this + pay 1 power to ready it. On conquer, pay 1 to ready this.

yiL.text: your units have +1 might. Level 11: your units enter ready.

reksaiL.text: When you conquer, may exhaust: reveal top 2, may play one, recycle the rest.

lilliaL.text: 4 energy, exhaust: play a ready 3-might Temporary Sprite; costs 1 less per friendly Temporary unit.

azirL.text: Sand Soldiers have Weaponmaster. 1 energy, exhaust: make a 2-might Sand Soldier if you played Equipment this turn.

viktorL.text: 1 energy, exhaust: play a 1-might Recruit token.

ezrealL.text: Exhaust (Reaction): draw 1, only if you've targeted enemy units/gear twice this turn with spells or unit abilities.

kennenL.text: Empowers when you play a card from anywhere but hand. Action: disempower + exhaust to give a unit Assault 2.

leblancL.text: On conquer or hold, may discard 1 + exhaust: make a ready Temporary Reflection token copying another unit there.

dariusL.text: Exhaust (Reaction, Legion): add 1 energy if you've played a card this turn.

rengarL.text: Whenever you play a unit, give a unit +1 might this turn.

targon.text: When you conquer here, ready 2 runes at end of turn.

zaun.text: When you conquer here, discard 1 then draw 1.

candle.text: When you conquer here, look at your top 2; recycle any; put the rest back in any order.

hoard.text: When you conquer here, may pay 1 energy to play an exhausted Gold gear token.

sigil.text: When you conquer here, recycle one of your runes.

monument.text: Players can't score here until their third turn.

kinkou.text: Units here with Tank have +1 might.

vilemaw.text: Units here can't move to base.

fortified.text: When you defend here, one unit gains Shield 2 this combat.

starspring.text: First time each turn a player plays a non-token unit here, they may send another of their units here to base.

waste.text: A unit defending here alone has -2 might.
